messages:
Alex (Sales): Heads-up: we're getting pushback from a midmarket POC because their SKU (pro-256) is being removed in next pricing slate. Need clarity on mapping to the new SKU for quoting and commit credit.
Mari - RevOps: Who's the account and what's the POC timeline?
Alex (Sales): AcmeHealth — POC ends 2026-05-12. They've been averaging ~120k tokens/day on hosted. They want a quote that won't blow up if the SKU is retired mid-POC.
Samir Eng: Technical note: the new SKU `standard-rt` has a slightly different latency profile and is quantization-first. We should surface perf delta to the customer.
Liz (Legal): For SKU deprecations we typically offer 90-day grandfathering for active commits if the DealDesk request is submitted before the commit execution.
Alex (Sales): Is that documented somewhere? I need a short blurb to paste into the quote.
Mari - RevOps: Quick pasteable mapping you can include:
```
legacy_sku: pro-256
replacement_sku: standard-rt
grandfathering_days: 90
commit_crediting: true
```
Samir Eng: Also add a note about fallback variants if they enable cost-optimization: `fallback: standard-rt-quant`.
DealDesk Bot: New request created: DD-8423 by Alex (Sales) — awaiting RevOps approval.
Mari - RevOps: @Liz can you confirm legal signoff on 90 days + one-time credit? If yes I'll approve and route to finance for pricing override.
Liz (Legal): Confirmed. Please include: "Grandfathering applies to active commits only; no retroactive changes to SLAs; customer must accept mapped SKU terms." I will drop a two-line clause.
Alex (Sales): Perfect. Any objections to applying this mapping to all active POCs started before 2026-04-01?
Samir Eng: From infra side we're OK. Caveat: if the POC uses Dedicated GPU features (e.g., tensor cores) we need to map to dedicated instance classes separately — ping me with those accounts.
Mari - RevOps: We'll scope this initial mapping to Hosted + Dedicated L1 only. @Finance FYI — need an expected revenue delta so we can approve the credit.
Finance (Tessa): Saw this — can you attach a simple estimate? rough calc: 120k tokens/day * 30 days = 3.6M tokens/month; delta ~ $0.01/token = ~$36k/month impact (back-of-envelope).
Alex (Sales): I'll update DD-8423 with the POC timeline and this estimate. Can we aim to finalize by EOW?
Liz (Legal): I'll push the clause today and attach to the DealDesk request.
Mari - RevOps: Approving routing pending finance confirmation. Routing back to @Alex to finalize quote and notify customer.
Alex (Sales): Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll update the quote and ping the customer once DD-8423 has the attachments.
